title: CzzzzzzJ/mdldm-maitian
why_read: A multi-platform social media publishing and analytics dashboard for Chinese platforms, useful mainly to content creators rather than engineers broadly.
analysis: This tool centralizes publishing and data monitoring across platforms like Bilibili, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, WeChat Channels, YouTube, and X, with notification integration via Feishu cards. It's a business/operations tool for social media managers rather than something offering novel technical architecture. The engineering involved (multi-platform API integration, dashboarding) is reasonably standard. Relevance to a general software engineering digest is limited.
